description: This file is a Perl script used for processing target metadata, generating configuration snippets, and parsing profile data for a build system. It defines functions for extracting features, naming targets, generating configuration strings, and handling dependencies related to target systems and profiles.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates configuration feature flags based on provided feature names.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the target, concatenating parent and current target names if a parent exists.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings with dots to underscore-separated format, normalizing to match kernel version tags.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Outputs configuration snippets for a specific target, including features, dependencies, and subtargets.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two package lists, avoiding duplicates and respecting prefixed removal indicators.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Main function to generate comprehensive target configuration scripts, including choices, profiles, and dependencies.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile metadata makefile snippets for a specified target.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to invoke appropriate generation functions.
